section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes findings from the current study of Black college women in the United States, reporting that the BAS produced reliable, valid scores and was moderately negatively related to BMI. It highlights associations among body appreciation, ethnic identity, and eating-related constructs, notes limitations (e.g., self-report measures, college sample), and calls for longitudinal and more diverse research; no explicit Study 1/Study 2 labels are used.
